When using `parseBody({ dot: true })` in HonoRequest, specially crafted form field names such as `__proto__.x` could create objects containing a `__proto__` property.

If the parsed result is later merged into regular JavaScript objects using unsafe merge patterns, this may lead to prototype pollution in the target object.

## Details

The `parseBody({ dot: true })` feature supports dot notation to construct nested objects from form field names.

In previous versions, the `__proto__` path segment was not filtered. As a result, specially crafted keys such as `__proto__.x` could produce objects containing `__proto__` properties.

While this behavior does not directly modify `Object.prototype` within Hono itself, it may become exploitable if the parsed result is later merged into regular JavaScript objects using unsafe merge patterns.

## Impact

Applications that merge parsed form data into regular objects using unsafe patterns (for example recursive deep merge utilities) may become vulnerable to prototype pollution.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00273, "percentile": 0.17567}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-03-11T00:31:47Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-56763"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-03-11T00:31:47Z", "references": ["https://github.com/honojs/hono/security/advisories/GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223", "https://github.com/honojs/hono/commit/ef902257e0beacbb83d2a9549b3b83e03514a6fe", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56763", "https://www.vulncheck.com/advisories/hono-prototype-pollution-via-proto-key-in-parsebody-with-dot-option", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/honojs/hono/security-advisories/GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/honojs/hono", "summary": "Hono vulnerable to Prototype Pollution possible through __proto__ key allowed in parseBody({ dot: true })", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-02T22:36:06Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-v8w9-8mx6-g223", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "4.12.7", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "hono"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 4.12.7"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
